name: Pulled by Strings
source:
The game tells the story of Eric, a wolf who wakes up one day in the middle of nowhere with no memories of his life and is quickly put in danger from an unknown force known as an 'Memory Outbreak.'

He is saved by what is known as a 'Representative', a person who has been gifted unique powers of unknown origin to deal with the outbreak. Following that, he then then tries his hardest to live out his day to day life, but quickly realises that things aren't as they seem: himself, the world and the people that inhabit it are filled to the brim with secrets, personal baggage and mysteries and its now your job to unravel them.

Will he make it out alive in one piece? Or will he and those around him go mad trying to find out who is really pulling the strings from behind the scenes?

[From [url=https://the-final-bear.itch.io/pulledbystrings]Itch.io[/url]]
